---
#title: "blog"
listing:
  # One row per series: a series' parts are reached from its index post, not listed here.
  contents:
    - "posts/*/index.qmd"
  # Series parts carry the series tag; only the series index (untagged) is listed.
  exclude:
    categories: "the-shape-of-a-sound"
  sort: "date desc"
  type: table
  fields: [date, title]
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: true
---
